stop.description: false to book a wakeup, with delaySeconds and prompt; true to cancel the wakeup you booked, such as once what you waited on reached you first, with no other field.

delaySeconds.description: Seconds from now to wake up, held to 60 through 601200, a minute through 7 days less an hour. Required when stop is false; refused when stop is true.

prompt.description: What to do once it fires, as the first line of your next turn, such as `Read the checks on pull request #<number>`. Required when stop is false; refused when stop is true.
